claim: A document that has lived for weeks in a non-git-tracked private folder has never been checked by any linter the target repo enforces -- expect real, pre-existing markdownlint/hygiene debt on first mirror into a CI-gated repo, not just the new content added during the mirror itself; run the actual linter, not a visual read, before treating a long-lived draft as CI-ready.

decisions.notes: agent-envelope: agent=claude-main model=claude-sonnet-5 date=2026-09-17 | The 6 OSSF draft documents (2026-09-16-ossf-part0..4 + publication plan) had lived only in OpenClaw's non-git references/ folder since authoring. First markdownlint-cli2 pass on the orama-system mirror found ~45 pre-existing table/line-length/fenced-code-language violations that had nothing to do with my own additions -- confirmed by running the linter, not assumed from a clean visual read of the source.
